en.hubeali:
From him, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Saeed, from someone else, 
‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> was asked about the gracious living of the world.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Spaciousness of the home and the abundance of those that love you’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Mansur ibn al-‘Abbas from Sa‘id from more than one person who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was asked about the excellence of the worldly life.
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is in spacious house and in the great number of friends.’”
